summary: The ReportWizardGenerator is a system designed to generate reports based on provided data and specifications. This system includes functionality for mapping attribute names to column titles in various languages, handling different locales, and integrating data from XML files into structured reports.
purpose: To generate structured reports by mapping data attributes to column titles, accommodating multiple languages and locales.

workflows.name: Report Generation
steps: Initialize Report object with reportName, outputFormat, reportHeader.
Set report title using reportHeader parameter.
Assign localized column titles from colTitle and colTitleAlt.
Determine report locale setting from IsUsingDefaultLocale.
Generate report using provided dataFilePath and filePath.

business_rules: Invalid reportName or XML will return a code of -1.
validations: Check for null values in dataFilePath, filePath, reportName, outputFormat, and IsUsingDefaultLocale before generating the report.
system_behavior: Generates a structured report based on provided specifications and data.
content_gaps: Detailed processing logic within the report generation is not explicitly defined.
